full_details: You came down before the house and ate the soft side of the loaf. The almanac showed the new moon and stopped at the day. On the way north you passed Yaxley's basin. At the Theatre Humphrey laid out Gaunt's roll, York's, and the Queen's. John said paper first, then mouths. You backed eightpence out of the stock, and Humphrey set the small sign on all three. Nick spoke the new cue once. Edith put a stitch in the afternoon coat, and the stock stayed at the copying. Coming home you read a fencers' bill at the Curtain and walked on. At dinner the jaw took the crust. You played in the afternoon. Between your exits you stayed in the tiring-house. Before the yard was let out, George Bryan told you Philip Howard, Earl of Arundel, had died in the Tower on Sunday. John had had it since noon, from a man who had it from the parish. You carried it home and spoke it in the chamber. From the corner of the lane you saw Crosby Place, the gate shut. The house had broth and the crabs. At night you wrote two lines and Nurse on a loose leaf, and the red bundle stayed tied. Under the dark close you spoke the death once, as George had told it.
one_sentence: You made three rolls of the king play agree, played the afternoon, wrote Juliet with the vial, and heard from George that Arundel died on Sunday.
title: Three rolls agreed, the afternoon play, and Arundel's death
